title: Fair Sunday weather in most parts of PH; ‘habagat’ to affect S. Luzon
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The southwest monsoon or “habagat” will prevail over the western section of Luzon while the rest of the country is expected to have fair weather with chances of rain…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The southwest monsoon or “habagat” will prevail over the western section of Luzon while the rest of the country is expected to have fair weather with chances of rain on Sunday, according to the state weather bureau.
